# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game titled Playroom Possession: Toybox Takedown. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: a single-player canvas grid survival loop where the player starts at the center, taps the current or orthogonally adjacent tile, marks rooms visited, draws and resolves random cards, manages HP/Stitches and SAN/Nerve, reveals a hidden exit through a good card, wins by reaching the revealed exit, and loses when either stat reaches zero. Reinterpret the game through this prompt: Killer doll horror. A satirical game inspired by Chucky with toy-sized menace, domestic chaos, dark comedy violence, possession mythology, absurd horror energy, and sneaky close-quarters attacks with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range. The public surface should be one inline `index.html` using vanilla Canvas/CSS/JS, procedural possessed-doll art, domestic playroom horror motifs, satirical toy-sized attack copy, readable portrait HUD, native tap buttons, and catalog-backed horror fonts/audio/GIF feedback.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first canvas grid survival/evasion card adventure.
- objective: Move through adjacent grid rooms, survive random event cards, reveal the hidden exit item, then reach that revealed exit before either health or sanity reaches zero.
- input model: Pointer/touch/click on the canvas; only current tile or orthogonally adjacent tiles are accepted during PLAY. Buttons use native click/tap for start, card resolution, and restart.
- core loop: Start at grid center, tap a reachable tile, mark it visited, draw one random card, resolve good/bad/neutral effect, update HUD/log, continue until the revealed exit is reached or HP/SAN reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: Random bad cards reduce HP or SAN; a modal card gate pauses movement until resolved; fail screen appears at HP <= 0 or SAN <= 0.

## Protected mechanics
- 5x5 default grid with configurable gridSize retained.
- Start HP 100 and start SAN/Nerve 100 retained through config.
- Movement acceptance remains same tile or Manhattan-adjacent tile during PLAY only.
- Every valid move enters CARD state unless it reaches the revealed exit.
- Card draw probabilities remain 40% neutral, 30% bad, 30% good.
- Good card effects remain +20 SAN/Nerve, reveal nearby tiles, or reveal exit.
- Bad card effects remain -25 HP, -25 SAN/Nerve, or -10 SAN/Nerve.
- Win requires exit revealed and player moving onto the exit tile.
- Loss requires HP <= 0 or SAN/Nerve <= 0.

## Remixed target
A portrait-first domestic horror comedy called Playroom Possession: Toybox Takedown. The same adjacency/grid/card/exit loop becomes a toy-sized survival crawl through a cursed apartment playroom: the player is a trapped babysitter at carpet level, HP is Stitches, SAN is Nerve, the exit reveal is the possessed doll's banishment tag, and random cards are satirical close-quarters toy attacks, possession gags, and absurd household survival aids. Presentation, HUD language, focal doll silhouette, background, audio, and feedback are transformed while mechanic truth is preserved.
